title: fix(proxy): report tool_use and keep unindexed parallel tool calls apart

files.patch:
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@ All notable changes to DreamCoder will be documented in this file.
 
 ### Fixed
 
+- **Tool calls from Gemini and similar OpenAI-compatible providers:** a turn that ends with finish_reason `stop` after calling tools now reaches Claude Code as `tool_use`, so the tools run. Parallel calls streamed without an `index` are no longer merged into one.
 - **Agent teams:** opening a teammate from the team view shows its conversation instead of an empty page.
   - Each teammate now keeps one transcript. Before, every message it received started a new file with its whole history copied in.
   - Transcripts written before this update still open.

+// Some OpenAI-compatible servers (Gemini's endpoint) stream every parallel call whole,
+// in its own chunk, without `tool_calls[].index`. A delta without an index starts a new
+// call when it brings an id that differs from the latest call's, or a name after the
+// latest call already has one; anything else continues the latest call.
+function toolCallKey(
+  tc: { index?: number; id?: string; function?: { name?: string } },
+  state: StreamState,
+): number {
+  if (typeof tc.index === 'number') return tc.index
+  let lastKey: number | undefined
+  for (const key of state.toolBlocks.keys()) lastKey = key
+  if (lastKey === undefined) return 0
+  const last = state.toolBlocks.get(lastKey)!
+  const startsNewCall = (!!tc.id && tc.id !== last.id) || (!tc.id && !!tc.function?.name && !!last.name)
+  return startsNewCall ? lastKey + 1 : lastKey
+}
